package.description: TokenTool removes much of the tedium from creating tokens for use with MapTool or your favorite online gaming application.

en-US.description: TokenTool removes much of the tedium from creating tokens for use with MapTool or your favorite online gaming application.
en-US.longDescription: TokenTool removes much of the tedium from creating tokens for use with MapTool or your favorite online gaming application. Just drag an image into the background, select a frame, zoom and pan to suit, and drag off a finished token. The resulting token is transparent around the edges and cropped to the size you wanted.
en-US.name: TokenTool
